headline: No rostered players play Thursday night. For Sunday, start Brissett over Hurts, keep Hall benched, and watch McLaurin's hamstring before Monday.
alerts: Thu Oct 15, 5:15 PM: Seahawks at Broncos. None of your players are in this game, nothing to set tonight.
Broncos ruled out CB Pat Surtain II and S Talanoa Hufanga. Not relevant to your roster.
Breece Hall worked off to the side Thursday and is still week-to-week. Keep him on the bench.
Terry McLaurin (hamstring) was limited Thursday. He plays Monday 5:15 PM, so have a Sunday night or Monday backup ready.
Josh Downs (hamstring, partly rest) was limited Wednesday. Expected to play, check Friday's report.
Michael Penix (ribs) practiced fully Wednesday, good news for Robinson.
Saquon Barkley missed practice again Thursday. DeVonta Smith upgraded to limited.
Sun 10:00 AM: Robinson, Downs, Hurts and Jets D lock. 1:05 PM: Brissett. 1:25 PM: Mitchell. 5:20 PM: Lloyd, Golden, Ferguson. Mon 5:15 PM: McLaurin.
No kicker shows in the tracked roster. Add one before Sunday 10:00 AM if you have not.
Sleeper could not be reached this run, so the roster is from the Tuesday run. Confirm any Tuesday adds in the app.

ARI.note: At Rams Sunday 1:05 PM Pacific. Rams -12.5, total 52.5. Arizona about 20 implied points.

PHI.note: Vs. Carolina Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. Eagles -1.5, total 41.5. Barkley missed practice again Thursday, DeVonta Smith limited.

ATL.note: Vs. Chicago Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. Bears about -3.5, total 49.5, Falcons about 23 implied. Penix (ribs) practiced fully Wednesday and is likely to start.

LAC.note: At Kansas City Sunday 1:25 PM Pacific. Chiefs -8.5, total 42.5. McConkey (foot) and several WRs limited Wednesday.

GB.note: Vs. Dallas Sunday night 5:20 PM Pacific. Packers -1.5, total 52.5, about 27 implied. Still no timeline on Josh Jacobs.

DAL.note: At Green Bay Sunday night 5:20 PM Pacific. Lamb was a full practice Wednesday and Thursday.

WAS.note: At San Francisco Monday 5:15 PM Pacific. 49ers -7.5, total 50.5. McLaurin (hamstring) limited Thursday.

IND.note: Vs. Tennessee Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. Colts -6.5, total 43.5. Downs limited Wednesday with a hamstring.

NYJ.note: At New England Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. Patriots -7.5, total 43.5. Hall still week-to-week.

SEA.note: Thursday night at Denver, 5:15 PM Pacific. Seahawks -3, total about 41. No rostered players. JSN was limited with an ankle.

DEN.note: Thursday night vs. Seattle, 5:15 PM Pacific. Surtain and Hufanga are inactive. No rostered players.

notes: Props: 242.5 passing yards, 1.5 TD with the over at plus money, 36.5 attempts. Works out to about 14.5 points assuming about 1 INT and a few rushing yards.

Arizona is a 12.5-point underdog at the Rams with a 52.5 total, so pass volume should stay high.
